name: SendEmailMessage
description: Sends an email using the mailkit.Provide valid email and app password credentials, sender and recipient details, subject, body, and optional attachments. The connector will return the response data.
author: @gaurav

fields.name: __CredentialName__GeneralCredential
fields.label: Email Credential
fields.description: The Email credential containing valid email and app password which is used to authenticate user requests.

fields.name: Attachments
fields.label: Attachments
fields.description: Paths to files to attach to the email (comma-separated).

fields.name: SecurityProtocol
fields.label: Security Protocol
fields.description: is a set of rules or procedures that govern the transmission and exchange of data between two or more devices over a network.

fields.name: SmtpServer
fields.label: Smtp Server
fields.description: Smtp server is a communication protocol used for sending and receiving email messages over the Internet

fields.name: ServerPort
fields.label: ServerPort
fields.description: The port number used to connect to the IMAP server. Default is 587

fields.name: SmtpServerNeedsAuthentication
fields.label: Smtp Server Needs Authentication
fields.description: Smtp Server Needs Authentication to authenticate the credentials.

fields.name: IsHtml
fields.label: Is Html
fields.description: The message is in html format.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the response data from mailkit after sending the email.
